litcurate2_join.exact_sentence: FD is a progressive, multisystemic disease requiring early clinical recognition by clinicians to avoid life-threatening complications of renal failure, heart failure, arrhythmias, and stroke.
Aortic involvement is generally progressive, and with a growing aortic root diameter, the risk of dissection increases.

litcurate2_excluded.considered_statement: Sickle cell disease (SCD) is a hereditary hemoglobinopathy caused by a point mutation in the β-globin gene, leading to the production of hemoglobin S and resulting in chronic hemolytic anemia, vaso-occlusion, and progressive organ damage.
litcurate2_excluded.exclusion_reason: the cohort entity C0002895 is the SPECIFIC homozygous-SS genotype (Hb SS disease / sickle cell anaemia), whereas the only retrievable OA disease-level progression statement is scoped to the SICKLE CELL DISEASE UMBRELLA (SCD), which spans the HbSS, HbSC and HbS/beta-thalassaemia genotypes; although the frozen R3 progression function WOULD map this sentence to 0.5 ('progressive organ damage', non-spectrum), the magnitude is asserted for the umbrella, not for the HbSS entity's own dominant untreated sequela, and a deliberate OA full-text search ('sickle cell anaemia'[Title] AND progressive, PMC open-access) found no entity-specific disease-level progression sentence exposed in retrievable open-access full text (entity-specific articles bury it in non-efetch-captured introductions). P left [O], not lifted

litcurate2_excluded.considered_statement: However, the clinical phenotype of SCD varies widely, influenced by additional cellular and genetic factors, which could explain, at least partially, why some individuals have very severe disease with frequent vaso-occlusive complications and early morbidity and death at a very young age, whereas others can go unnoticed until adulthood.
litcurate2_excluded.exclusion_reason: an OA source predicates WIDE within-entity phenotypic variability ('varies widely ... some individuals have very severe disease ... whereas others can go unnoticed until adulthood'); under the BURDEN_INDEX severity-spectrum rule a mild-to-severe range is scored at the [H] midpoint not an extreme, and the frozen R3 spectrum_S override TRIPS on this sentence, so a clean non-spectrum disease-level severe tier is not defensibly isolable. S kept [O] (no anchored disease-level severity)

litcurate2_excluded.considered_statement: The development of emphysema and decline in lung function varies by AATD genotype and is accelerated by risk factors, such as smoking.
litcurate2_excluded.exclusion_reason: alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency progression is predicated as GENOTYPE-DEPENDENT and variable ('varies by AATD genotype'), and the cohort entity spans a genotype spectrum (PiZZ, PiSZ, rare variants) with two distinct dominant sequelae (pulmonary emphysema vs hepatic cirrhosis) whose untreated courses differ; a single disease-level progression magnitude is therefore not defensibly isolable for the umbrella entity, and the available OA statements describe variability rather than an anchored untreated-progression tier. P left [O], not lifted
